item.tib: skra gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod 'bul tshogs bsags thog mar mar me 'bul ba'i le'u shog chung ye shes rab gsal
item.coloph: de ltar sku gsum rig 'dzin dgongs 'dus kyi/ cha lag kha bskangs gsang sngags mkhan po rnams/ skal bzang lam zhugs smag rum sel ba'i ched/ thos chung rig 'dzin pad+ma bdud 'dul gyis/ bgyis pas dge ba sems can don du bsngo/ de mthus sku gsum go 'phang thob par shog bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan drug shog/
